01 — THE APPROACH

One chapter.
Three simple
moves.

Preparation gets easier when you know what to do next.

01

Understand it.

Start with the idea. Break a chapter into concepts that make sense before moving ahead.

02

Work through it.

Put your understanding to work with questions. Notice the gaps, then give them another try.

03

Come back to it.

Revisit the key points. A little revision today makes the next chapter feel less overwhelming.
